Source: https://cadmus.io/

# Icon manifest for specs/pages-content.md

CSS data-URI icons extracted verbatim from the live site stylesheet (inlined `<style>` on every page). Use as `background-image: url("<data-uri>")`.

| Selector | Usage | Box |
|---|---|---|
| `.share-icon.linkedin/.facebook/.twitter/.download` | Share block (N6) | 30x30 tile, bg #ECE6DF, r2, icon `background-size:18px auto` centred |
| `.accordion--arrow` | Mobile Topics toggle (N2) | 28x28, contain |
| `.arrow-button.down::after` | Load more (N3) | 16x16, rotates 180deg when `.active` |
| `.video-play` | Related video rows (N17) | 9.6px wide, aspect 4/5 |
| `.contact-form-close` | Download accordion close (N6) | 24x24 |
| `.arrow-button.orange::after` | orange arrow variant (declared; not rendered on these routes) | 30px wide, aspect 2.31/1 |
| `.arrow-button.previous::before` | previous-arrow variant (declared; not rendered) | 30px wide |

## Note pin (inline SVG, from original `src/components/articleContent.js`)
Fill colours come from `.note--wrapper` CSS vars: `rect` = `--icon-background`, `path` = `--icon` (see N7 colour table).
